description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal.

features.name: Darkvision
features.tldr: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.tldr: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

features.name: Stonecunning
features.tldr: You add double your proficiency bonus to History checks related to the origin of stonework.

features.name: Dwarven Subrace
features.tldr: Choose a dwarven subrace such as Hill Dwarf or Mountain Dwarf.

features.name: Dwarven Fortitude
features.tldr: You can tap into your hardy nature to shrug off wear and tear during rests.

features.name: Steadfast Resolve
features.tldr: You gain extra resilience against being frightened or knocked prone.
